title: Perimeter, your way
prompt: The robot measures a rectangular room and reports the distance around it, through a `print_perimeter` helper whose parameters are yours to decide. report_perimeter(3, 4) prints 14.
hints: The perimeter is twice the width plus twice the height, so the helper needs both; report_perimeter calls it with the width and height.
report_perimeter passes its two values straight through.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
